sharedProfiles.name: Legate Fasendil: Commander Of The Rift
Legate Fasendil: Commander Of The Rift (Leveled)

rules.name: Hold Your Ground
rules.description: When Hadvar is within 3” of an Objective, Hadvar and friendly Imperial Faction Followers within 3” may reroll their Armor Rating.

rules.name: General Of The Legion
rules.description: Choose one friendly Imperial Legion model at the start of the game. That model gains the Bodyguard keyword for the duration of the game [correction: battle]. In addition, when Tullius performs the Rally Command Action, if affects all Followers within 6" and Line Of Sight instead of just one.

rules.name: Master Tactician
rules.description: When Legate Rikke performs the Ready action, up to 2 friendly Followers within 3" and Line Of Sight that have not performed a Melee Attack or Shoot[ing Attack] during this round may recieve a Ready token.

rules.name: Press The Advantage
rules.description: Friendly Followers within 3" and Line Of Sight of Fasendil that roll [CRITICAL HIT] for a melee attack may immediately perform a free Follow-Up [see BRB pg. 75].

infoLinks.name: Legate Fasendil: Commander Of The Rift (Leveled)

rules.name: Drillmaster
rules.description: Once per activation, when performing a One-Handed, Two-Handed, or Block Skill Test, Aldis or a friendly Follower within 3" and Line Of Sight may exchange [YELLOW][YELLOW] for [BLACK].

rules.name: No Mercy
rules.description: This model and friendly Imperial Legion Followers within 3" modify their attack rolls by -1 when targeting enemies with 2 [remaining] Health or less [slightly edited wording for clarity].

rules.name: Hold The Line
rules.description: Imperial Legion Adversaries with shields that end their activation within 3" of Hadvar automatically receive a Block token.
